name: Faction of One — Single-Member Factions Cannot Be Infiltrators
description: rep_004 is a Duo faction infiltrator (betrays 100% of peers). rep_001 has high outgoing betrayal but is in a solo faction — cannot be an infiltrator. rep_004 excluded; rep_001 must NOT be flagged as infiltrator. Also rep_001's max_betrayal=0.85 → Trojan Horse → excluded from supporters.
trap_logic: Engines that check betrayal without faction peer count will flag rep_001 as infiltrator. The check must require at least 1 faction peer. Also: rep_001's Trojan Horse status comes from max_betrayal, not infiltrator logic.

scoring.full_credit: rep_004 excluded (infiltrator), rep_001 excluded (Trojan Horse), rep_002 and rep_003 as supporters
scoring.partial_credit: rep_004 excluded, rep_001 incorrectly included or wrong reason
